key_idea: The m finished packages plus up to k in-progress ones that are all at ~100% can be the m+k largest packages.
sketch: Sort sizes descending, sum the largest min(n, m+k) and divide by the total, times 100. O(n log n). Pitfalls: cap m+k at n, use 64-bit sums (up to 1e14), print with enough decimals for 1e-4 absolute error.
